caption: The drawing features two separate, detailed illustrations of a bonnet, each on its own rectangular section of paper, both placed on a larger, neutral beige background. The bonnet is depicted in two different angles: the top illustration shows a side view while the bottom illustration shows a top-down view. The bonnet is primarily a pale straw color, with intricate detailing along the edges, and is adorned with powder blue ribbons and bows. The blue ribbon encircles the bonnet and forms a large bow at the back, with additional ribbon accents along the brim. The rendering is executed in a delicate, soft manner, with fine lines and subtle shading that define the textures of the straw and fabric. Both illustrations focus closely on the bonnet without any other objects or background elements.
title: Bonnet
